articles.title: A U.S. Navy Destroyer Just Completed 11-Month-Long Epic Deployment
articles.summary: The Arleigh Burke-class guided-missile destroyer USS Mitscher (DDG 57) returned to Naval Station Norfolk after an extensive 11-month deployment. Operating in the U.S. 5th and 6th Fleet areas, the destroyer conducted maritime security operations, showcasing sustained naval presence and capabilities in critical international waters. This highlights the U.S. Navy's global operational reach and commitment to regional stability.

articles.title: Telegram ban: HC asks government to present proof that justifies blocking
articles.summary: The Delhi High Court has sought responses from MeitY, Home Affairs, and the National Testing Agency concerning a prominent messaging platform, likely Telegram. This judicial move highlights increasing scrutiny over such platforms' operations in India. Potential concerns include content regulation, user data privacy, or platform misuse for activities like exam malpractices, given NTA's involvement. The court awaits detailed replies from the ministries.

articles.title: The 'Italian Alcatraz' that transformed into a stunning national park
articles.summary: Freediver Alessandro describes Sardinia as having unparalleled environmental integrity, a rarity even across the entire Mediterranean. He suggests only a handful of locations can rival its pristine condition. This assessment underscores Sardinia's unique ecological value and exceptional natural preservation, positioning it as a standout example of environmental health in a vital international maritime region.

articles.title: India’s annual defence production surges to Rs 1.78 lakh cr in 2025-26
articles.summary: India's defence production achieved an all-time high of Rs 1.78 lakh crore in the financial year 2025-26, the Defence Ministry announced. This significant milestone underscores the nation's growing self-reliance (Aatmanirbharta) in defence manufacturing. Such robust growth strengthens India's strategic capabilities and reduces dependence on foreign imports, contributing to national security.

articles.title: As The US Pulls Back, NATO Ponies Up
articles.summary: NATO allies are initiating efforts to replace approximately $50 billion worth of U.S. military assets, including planes, ships, and drones, which are being removed from NATO crisis response allocations. This strategic move ensures the alliance maintains its operational readiness and collective defence capabilities amidst ongoing international challenges. The development, crucial for global security dynamics, was reported by Reuters, citing anonymous military sources.

articles.title: Focus on investment-friendly ecosystem in new industrial policy: Minister
articles.summary: High drama unfolded at the G7 summit as Senator Rubio reportedly translated for former President Trump following awkward facial gestures. Separately, a significant defence incident occurred as a Hezbollah drone struck an Israeli rescue vehicle after an initial attack, injuring five people. This highlights ongoing regional tensions and cross-border conflict, crucial for understanding contemporary security challenges.
